Title: Empty state table headers remain visible when no workflows exist
Description: The Workflows screen shows table headers (Name, Family, Status, Version, Last Promotion) even when the empty state is displayed, creating visual confusion about whether the table is actually empty or just loading.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Workflows screen with empty database 2. Observe empty state card 3. Check if table headers are visible below/above empty state message
Root_Cause: Missing CSS rule to hide table headers during empty state
Impact: Users may be confused about the actual table state and whether content is loading

Title: Search box not clearly disabled during loading state
Description: When the Workflows screen is loading, the search box appears grayed but doesn't have a clear visual indicator (no tooltip/disabled attribute) that searching is unavailable.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Refresh Workflows page 2. Immediately try typing in search box during skeleton load 3. Observe search box behavior
Root_Cause: Missing accessibility attributes and visual feedback styling
Impact: Users may attempt searches during load and experience unexpected behavior

Title: Bulk action toolbar position inconsistent
Description: Documentation shows bulk actions appearing 'above or below table' but actual behavior is unclear - position relative to selected rows is not specified.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Workflows 2. Load table with 20+ workflows 3. Select multiple rows 4. Observe toolbar position 5. Scroll table 6. Check if toolbar remains visible
Root_Cause: Missing specification and implementation detail
Impact: Users may miss bulk actions if toolbar is positioned off-screen or scrolls out of view

Title: Export functionality shows format dropdown but no error handling for export failures
Description: The export state (5.5) shows 'Exporting...' spinner, but State 5.6 doesn't document timeout behavior or what happens if export fails mid-process.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Analytics 2. Select CSV export 3. Kill network connection during export 4. Observe UI behavior
Root_Cause: No explicit error recovery flow for mid-export failures
Impact: User may see spinner indefinitely or get stuck without retry option

Title: OAuth timeout handling missing in documentation
Description: The WhatsApp linking modal specifies 5-minute timeout, but actual behavior when timeout occurs is not documented (does modal close? Show error? Retry available?)
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Channels 2. Click 'Link WhatsApp' 3. Wait 5+ minutes without completing OAuth 4. Observe result
Root_Cause: Unclear error handling for OAuth flow timeout
Impact: User experience during timeout is unpredictable - may confuse user if modal suddenly closes

Title: Telegram bot token displayed partially masked ('123456:ABC***XYZ') but masking algorithm not specified
Description: If token has special characters, masking may fail or expose sensitive data incorrectly.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Link Telegram bot with complex token 2. View channel details 3. Check if token masking is consistent
Root_Cause: Insufficient input validation for token masking
Impact: Token could be partially exposed if special characters break masking logic

Title: Unsaved changes detection doesn't account for node drag operations
Description: Sidebar shows 'Unsaved changes' badge only after explicit node property edits, but doesn't detect when user drags/repositions nodes on canvas without changing properties.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Open workflow in editor 2. Load existing workflow with nodes 3. Drag node to different position on canvas 4. Check 'Unsaved changes' indicator
Root_Cause: Canvas drag operation doesn't trigger change detection listener
Impact: Users may lose node position changes if they navigate away or page reloads

Title: Save error doesn't provide retry mechanism with backoff
Description: State 8.10 shows save error banner with 'Retry' button, but no exponential backoff is implemented for rapid retries.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Workflow Editor 2. Make changes 3. Click Save 4. Interrupt network 5. Click Retry immediately 6. Retry again immediately
Root_Cause: Missing rate limiting and backoff implementation on retry button
Impact: Rapid retries may overwhelm backend or create duplicate entries

Title: Publish button accessibility unclear when workflow has multiple versions
Description: Documentation doesn't specify if 'Publish workflow for live use' modal should show version selection or if it always publishes the currently edited version.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Open workflow with 5+ versions 2. Edit current version 3. Look for Publish button 4. Click Publish 5. Check which version is being promoted
Root_Cause: Ambiguous requirements around version selection in publish flow
Impact: User may accidentally promote wrong version to production

Title: Filter dropdown doesn't persist selected value after page reload
Description: State 2.4 shows filter dropdown as 'All Types', 'AI Agents', 'Human Agents', but doesn't specify if selection persists in URL/localStorage after page refresh.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Agents 2. Filter to 'AI Agents' 3. Refresh page 4. Check if filter reverts to 'All Types'
Root_Cause: Missing filter state persistence implementation
Impact: User must re-apply filters on each page visit

Title: Search results pagination not specified in documentation
Description: State 3.5 shows real-time search filtering, but doesn't specify if results are paginated. If 1000+ skills match search, UI behavior is undefined.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Skills 2. Create 100+ test skills 3. Search for common name 4. Observe result pagination
Root_Cause: Undefined pagination behavior for large search result sets
Impact: Poor performance if all matching skills are rendered at once

Title: Timeout handler doesn't specify which routes completed successfully
Description: State 7.6 shows 'Validation timed out after 30 seconds, partial results shown' but doesn't clarify if results table shows passed routes with status indicator.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Demo Routes 2. Click 'Run Validation' 3. Wait for partial timeout 4. Check if failed routes are marked as 'Timeout' vs missing
Root_Cause: Unclear status distinction for timed-out routes
Impact: User cannot determine which routes need re-testing

Title: Delete confirmation doesn't show tenant user count or last activity date
Description: State 6.6 requires typing 'DELETE' but doesn't show tenant context (user count, last login, data volume) to prevent accidental deletion of active tenants.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Tenants (admin only) 2. Select active tenant with users 3. Click Delete 4. Check confirmation modal content
Root_Cause: Missing contextual information in confirmation dialog
Impact: Operator may accidentally delete active tenant with users

Title: Error banner doesn't auto-dismiss and may be missed by users
Description: All screens have persistent error banners (States 1.6, 2.6, etc.) without auto-dismiss timeout, but no documentation on how users are notified.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Trigger API error (disconnect network) 2. Observe error banner 3. Leave page for 5 minutes 4. Return to page
Root_Cause: Missing auto-dismiss timer or notification pattern for errors
Impact: User may miss critical error messages if focused on other UI elements

Title: Skeleton animation duration varies (500ms-2s per documentation) without explanation
Description: State X.2 (All screens) shows loading skeletons with duration '500ms-2s', but no logic is documented for when each duration is used.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to different screens 2. Refresh rapidly 3. Time skeleton duration across screens
Root_Cause: Inconsistent loading state timing logic
Impact: User perceives some screens as 'sluggish' compared to others

Title: Token expiry warning not documented
Description: Auth flow shows 24-hour expiry but no warning is shown before token expires. User may be suddenly logged out without notice.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Authenticate as admin 2. Wait near 24-hour mark 3. Check if warning appears before logout
Root_Cause: Missing pre-expiry notification implementation
Impact: User loses work if working near token expiry without saving

Title: Bootstrap redirect destination not validated against referrer
Description: Auth flow shows '?redirect=/ui/workflows' parameter, but no validation prevents malicious redirects to external sites (open redirect vulnerability).
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Call /dev/auth/bootstrap/admin?redirect=https://evil.com 2. Check if user is redirected off-site
Root_Cause: Missing URL validation in redirect parameter
Impact: Potential security vulnerability allowing phishing attacks

Title: Sort direction indicators not specified in detail
Description: State 1.3 shows 'sort indicators (▲/▼)' but doesn't specify which column defaults to sorted, or if multi-column sort is supported.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Workflows 2. Load table 3. Check initial sort column 4. Click header A then B 5. Observe sort behavior
Root_Cause: Ambiguous sort behavior documentation
Impact: Users may misunderstand sort order or default sorting

Title: Form error messages lack clear positioning relative to fields
Description: Component documentation shows 'error state' but doesn't specify if errors appear above/below/inside field, or if error summary is shown.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Open any form (Create Workflow/Agent/Skill) 2. Submit with invalid data 3. Check error message positioning
Root_Cause: Missing form error layout specification
Impact: Users may not immediately see which field has an error

Title: Jump-to-page input doesn't specify validation or bounds checking
Description: State 1.8 shows pagination with 'option to jump to specific page', but doesn't document behavior if user enters page 999 when only 5 pages exist.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to paginated list (Workflows) 2. Type invalid page number in jump field 3. Observe validation
Root_Cause: No explicit validation logic for jump-to-page input
Impact: User may see empty results or error if invalid page entered

Title: OAuth callback URI validation not documented
Description: WhatsApp/Telegram OAuth flows don't specify what callback URI is expected, making integration testing difficult.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Attempt to link WhatsApp 2. Capture OAuth redirect URL 3. Check if callback URI matches backend expectation
Root_Cause: Ambiguous OAuth callback URI specification
Impact: Integration issues with WhatsApp/Telegram OAuth providers possible

Title: 'Last 24h', 'Last 7d', 'Last 30d' buttons don't specify if custom date range is supported
Description: State 5.4 shows fixed time ranges but doesn't document if users can pick custom dates, or if UTC vs local time is used.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Analytics 2. Look for custom date picker 3. Check time zone handling
Root_Cause: Missing custom date range specification
Impact: Users may be unable to analyze specific date periods

Title: Active navigation indicator not specified for current screen
Description: Sidebar state documentation doesn't specify if current screen nav item has visual highlighting, bold text, or underline.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Navigate to Workflows screen 2. Check if nav item shows active state 3. Navigate to Agents 4. Check if previous nav item loses active state
Root_Cause: Ambiguous active navigation styling
Impact: Users may not clearly see which screen they're currently viewing

Title: Mobile table conversion to card view doesn't specify card field order
Description: Responsive state shows 'Tables convert to card view' but doesn't specify if card shows all fields or prioritizes critical fields.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Set viewport to 375px (mobile) 2. Navigate to table screen (Workflows) 3. Check card layout and field visibility
Root_Cause: Missing mobile card layout specification
Impact: Incomplete or incorrectly ordered information on mobile view

Title: Focus trap documentation missing for modals
Description: Component library shows 'focus trap' requirement but doesn't specify trap behavior when user tabs beyond modal (should cycle back to first button).
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Open any modal 2. Tab through all focusable elements 3. Tab beyond last element 4. Check if focus cycles to first element
Root_Cause: Missing focus trap implementation or unclear specification
Impact: Screen reader users may be unable to close modal if trapped in loop

Title: Multiple toast stacking position not specified
Description: Toast documentation shows 4 types but doesn't specify if multiple toasts stack vertically, horizontally, or queue.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Trigger multiple success messages rapidly 2. Observe toast stacking 3. Check if they overlap or stack
Root_Cause: Ambiguous multi-toast layout specification
Impact: Toasts may overlap and become unreadable

Title: No reconnection logic for pages left open during network outage
Description: API errors are documented, but no auto-retry or reconnection logic is specified when network comes back online.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Load Workflows screen 2. Disable network (airplane mode) 3. Re-enable network 4. Check if page auto-refreshes
Root_Cause: Missing network resilience implementation
Impact: Users must manually refresh page after network outage

Title: Invalid node connections not prevented in real-time
Description: State 8.9 shows validation errors after attempting save, but doesn't specify if invalid connections are visually prevented during drag operations.
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Open editor 2. Try to connect incompatible output port to incompatible input 3. Check if connection is prevented or allowed
Root_Cause: No real-time connection type validation during drag
Impact: Users may create invalid workflows that fail at save time

Title: No documentation for guest/viewer role behavior
Description: Role matrix shows admin/ops/analyst, but doesn't document what happens when unauthenticated user or guest views the app (redirect to login? 403 page?).
Reproduction_Steps: 1. Open app without authentication 2. Navigate to any screen 3. Check behavior
Root_Cause: Missing unauthenticated user handling specification
Impact: Unclear user flow for guests or expired sessions

Title: Bulk operation partial failure not specified (e.g.
Description: delete 3 of 5 workflows)
Reproduction_Steps: Test matrix covers success/failure but not partial success scenarios where some items in bulk operation succeed and others fail.
Root_Cause: 1. Select 5 workflows 2. Trigger bulk delete 3. Simulate failure on 2nd item 4. Check result
Impact: Missing partial failure handling specification
Status: Users may not understand why some items deleted and others didn't
